recommended_article_structure.heading: Why content lifecycle gates matter when agents move fast
recommended_article_structure.purpose: Open with the reader’s concern: agent-assisted work can accelerate content changes faster than teams can review them.

recommended_article_structure.heading: Think of the lifecycle as decisions, not just status labels
recommended_article_structure.purpose: Introduce checkout, validation, patching, publishing, and release carefully as decision gates.

claim_proof_map.claim: Lifecycle gates help teams make content changes deliberate rather than accidental.
claim_proof_map.allowed_wording: Governed lifecycle gates can help teams make content changes more deliberate and reviewable.

claim_proof_map.claim: High-impact advancement should be gated by clear ownership or authorization.
claim_proof_map.allowed_wording: Teams should treat publish and release decisions as authorized-owner or operator decisions.
claim_proof_map.avoid_wording: The platform enforces RBAC, approvals, or audit trails.

reader_next_step.primary_next_step: Use the checklist to review one content-object workflow before relying on it operationally, then confirm platform-specific behavior with documentation or an SME.

Do not instruct readers to publish or release content.

bodySchema.schemaVersion: json-schema draft 2020-12 as served by object_contract

slug.contractRule: must be unique across article objects and committed legacy posts

optionalRootFields.tracking: object; write only via set_tracking, not article meta ops
optionalRootFields.author: string maxLength 120
optionalRootFields.image: object {src required, alt optional}; rendered image src must be public path, not raw artifact ref
optionalRootFields.taxonomy: object {category:string, tags:string[]}; optional but unknown terms block
optionalRootFields.seo: object {meta_title, meta_description, canonical_url}; no additional properties
optionalRootFields.emotional_strategy: object of editorial texture arrays/strings; not rendered to reader HTML
optionalRootFields.sources: object with required source_list[]; each source requires name and url
optionalRootFields.claims: object with required claim_list[]; each claim requires text; optional risk/status/node_ids/source_ids/notes
optionalRootFields.compliance: object with required requirements[]; each requirement requires kind and text
optionalRootFields.scores: array of scored_by, at, framework, dimension, score, rationale

publicFields.body: string plain text or rich_text document object
publicFields.media: object with required type and src; type enum image, video, audio, embed, document

nodeSchema.commercialFields: available for commercial annotations but not needed for this brief; internals are never serialized into reader HTML

richText.hyperlinkRule: schema allows non-empty no-whitespace uri; live richtext constraint requires https:// href
richText.stringBodies: plain text only; escaped at render; blank lines split paragraphs; use rich_text document for formatting

rules: nodes are edited only via node ops, not set_article_meta
tracking is written only by set_tracking

objectId.creationRule: omit requested_id on object_create to have server mint the id
objectId.note: Other object types use prefixes such as page_, sec_, nav_, tax_, site_, tpl_, prod_; do not apply those patterns to content_item.

nodeIds.privacyRule: must not contain strategy or commercial vocabulary such as hook, agitation, cta

slug.uniqueness: unique across content_item article objects and committed legacy posts

mediaConvention.artifactProtocol: Major-Key artifact references plus public serving paths
mediaConvention.rawArtifactReferenceFields: only *AssetRef fields may hold raw refs; no *AssetRef field is needed for this text-only article

publicServingPathRules.image: raw image/{id}/{sha256}.{ext} becomes /img/{id}/{sha256}.{ext} in renderable src fields
publicServingPathRules.pdf: raw pdf/{id}/{sha256}.pdf becomes /pdf/{id}/{sha256}.pdf in renderable document media src or ctaLink

mediaConvention.remoteHttpsUrls: warn as ungoverned; do not use unless explicitly accepted by a human/admin
mediaConvention.textOnlyArticleGuidance: No media is required. Do not add image, public.media, public.images, embedded-asset-block, or PDF ctaLink unless an artifact is generated and verified under the declared protocol.
